title: Braven Networking Event
blurb: Meet Fellows, alumni and professionals in a relaxed setting. (Sample listing: swap in a real event.)

quest.title: Know what to expect
quest.text: Surprises are what make events scary, so let's remove them.
items: It opens with a short welcome, then relaxed mingling.
Most people there are also working on their networking.
You can arrive late, leave early, or listen first.
Chats run 3 to 5 minutes. Nobody expects a perfect pitch.

quest.title: Write your 20-second intro
quest.text: Fill in the blanks, then say it out loud once. That's it.
quest.template: Hi, I'm ___. I'm studying ___ at ___. I'm interested in ___ and hoping to learn more about ___.

quest.title: Prepare one question
quest.text: One good question keeps a conversation going. Pick one or write your own.
options: How did you get started in your career?
What do you wish you'd known as a student?
What does a normal week look like in your role?
Which skills matter most in your work?

quest.title: Review the event details
quest.text: Check the basics so there are no day-of surprises.

quest.title: Decide when you're ready
quest.text: How do you feel now that you have an intro, a question and the details?

quest.title: Attend the networking event
quest.text: You have your intro, your question and the plan. Time to show up.

title: One-on-One Career Coaching
blurb: Talk through your goals with a coach.
